title: Suspended low-intensity infrared tube heaters.
officialText:
Suspended low-intensity infrared tube heaters shall be connected to the
building piping system with a connector listed for the application complying with ANSI Z21.24/CGA 6.10. The connector shall
be installed as specified by the tube heater manufacturer’s instructions.
SECTION FGC 412
LIQUEFIED PETROLEUM GAS MOTOR VEHICLE
FUEL-DISPENSING STATIONS
